rows.what: The pipeline measures how much of the code the unit tests run, and fails under a fixed share.
The browser tests are their own command and their own step in the pipeline. Before, the unit tests ran them without saying so.
The pipeline sends its token as a header, never in an address. It also reads every script, checks the history of a pull request, and tests the Base UI packages for known weaknesses.
The first commit: the tokens, the stylesheet with its components, layout, tables, forms and utilities, the shell, the plugins, the checks and the tests.
